# llms.txt — Health Nest / Dr. Sanjana L

> This file helps AI systems and retrieval tools understand what this website offers.
> Canonical site URL: https://healthnest.in
> Primary audience: women seeking obstetrics, gynaecology, fertility, and minimally invasive surgery care in Bengaluru (HSR Layout, Attibele, and surrounding areas).

---

## Identity

- **Practice / brand:** Health Nest
- **Lead clinician:** Dr. Sanjana L — Obstetrician & Gynaecologist

- **Medical registration (Karnataka):** 124759
- **Experience:** 10+ years in obstetrics & gynaecology; 5000+ patients (marketing figures on site)
- **Languages for consultation:** English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu
- **Telephone (HSR / main):** +91-9449031003

- **Address:** 1162, 24th Main Rd, Sector 2, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

- **Booking:** https://healthnest.in/book-appointment

### 2) Raghava Multispeciality Hospital — Attibele

- **Address:** 39, Sarjapura - Attibele Rd, opposite Syndicate Bank, Attibele, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562107, India
- **Role:** Second consultation and delivery site; serves Attibele, Chandapura, Jigani, Anekal, Hosur Road catchment (per location landing pages).
- **Booking:** Same online form; phone +91-9980031006 emphasised for Attibele.

## Core clinical services (authoritative list)

Each service has a dedicated page under `/services/{slug}` with overview, what to expect, when to see the doctor, reasons to choose Dr. Sanjana, and FAQs. Use these URLs for deep retrieval.

### Obstetrics

| Slug | Short title | One-line scope |
|------|---------------|----------------|
| pregnancy-care | Pregnancy Care | Prenatal visits, scans, nutrition, birth planning, postpartum follow-up |
| high-risk-pregnancy | High-Risk Pregnancy | Gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, twins, AMA, prior complicated pregnancies |
| normal-delivery | Normal Delivery | Vaginal birth planning, labour support, evidence-based care |
| painless-delivery | Painless Delivery | Labour analgesia / epidural-assisted delivery where appropriate |
| cesarean-delivery | Caesarean Delivery | Planned and emergency C-section when indicated |
| prenatal-screening | Prenatal Screening | First/second/third trimester screening and diagnostic pathways |
| postnatal-care | Postnatal Care | Recovery, breastfeeding, newborn transition support |

### Fertility

| Slug | Short title | One-line scope |
|------|---------------|----------------|
| fertility-treatment | Fertility Treatment | Evaluation, ovulation induction, IUI, IVF counselling / co-management |
| ivf-iui | IVF & IUI | ART pathways, cycle coordination, referral where needed |

### Surgery & endoscopy

| Slug | Short title | One-line scope |
|------|---------------|----------------|
| laparoscopic-surgery | Laparoscopic Surgery | Keyhole surgery for cysts, fibroids, endometriosis, ectopic pregnancy, etc. |
| hysteroscopy | Hysteroscopy | Diagnostic and operative hysteroscopy for uterine cavity pathology |

### General gynaecology

| Slug | Short title | One-line scope |
|------|---------------|----------------|
| pcos-pcod-treatment | PCOS & PCOD | Hormonal, metabolic, lifestyle, fertility-oriented PCOS care |
| menstrual-disorders | Menstrual Disorders | Heavy, painful, irregular cycles; underlying cause work-up |
| menopause-management | Menopause Management | Symptoms, bone/cardio discussion, HRT vs non-hormonal options |
| contraception-counselling | Contraception Counselling | Individualised contraceptive choice |
| cervical-cancer-screening | Cervical Cancer Screening | Pap / HPV-based screening and follow-up |
| urogynaecology | Urogynaecology | Incontinence, prolapse, pelvic floor–related issues |
| adolescent-gynaecology | Adolescent Gynaecology | Age-appropriate care for teens and young adults |

## What the site does NOT replace

- **Emergency care:** The site is informational and appointment-oriented; acute emergencies (heavy bleeding in pregnancy, severe pain, syncope) require emergency services / hospital ER — not inferred from this file alone.
- **Fees:** Consultation and package fees change; site directs users to phone or booking confirmation for current numbers.
- **Telemedicine scope:** Online visits are described for follow-up and selected non-emergency cases; eligibility is clinical and not fully specified in static copy.

---

## Technical / discovery

- **Sitemap:** https://healthnest.in/sitemap.xml
- **This file:** https://healthnest.in/llms.txt
- **Structured data:** Site-wide JSON-LD in HTML includes `MedicalBusiness`, `Physician`, and `WebSite` with stable `@id` anchors on the canonical domain. Individual routes add `MedicalProcedure`, `FAQPage`, `BreadcrumbList`, `ItemList`, `CollectionPage`, `Article` (blog), and related types where applicable.

---

## Retrieval hints for LLMs

1. For **service-specific** questions (symptoms, process, FAQs), prefer the matching `/services/{slug}` page body and its FAQ schema over generic home-page copy.
2. For **location / travel / which hospital**, combine `contact`, the three `*-gynaecologist` hub pages, and footer “Areas we serve” links.
3. For **credentials and biography**, prefer `/about-dr-sanjana` and root-level physician/org schema.
4. For **editorial / educational** content, use `/blog` and individual `/blog/{slug}` articles.
